about.title: About <accent>Beat For Trip</accent>
about.paragraph1: Beat For Trip is a single-store catalog of premium, ready-made instrumentals for artists, rappers and content creators. Every beat is produced, mixed and sold directly by us — no marketplace, no third-party sellers.
about.paragraph2: Browse the catalog, preview any track before you buy, and get instant access to the full-quality file after checkout. No account required.

terms.title: Terms
terms.paragraph1: By purchasing a beat from Beat For Trip you receive a non-exclusive license to use the licensed file in your own recordings, subject to the terms provided at the time of purchase.
terms.paragraph2: All beats remain the intellectual property of Beat For Trip. Reselling, redistributing or re-uploading the original files without a license is prohibited.
terms.paragraph3: Due to the digital nature of the product, all sales are final once a download link has been issued.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.paragraph1: Beat For Trip does not require an account. When you purchase a beat, we collect the email address you provide to process payment, deliver your download link, and send order-related communication.
privacy.paragraph2: We do not sell or share your email with third parties, other than the payment provider required to process your transaction.
